options.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic, production-quality AYRA MARKETING WEBSITE homepage visual concept named "Quiet Editorial". One independent design, not a comparison board. Target canvas 1440 px wide by 2000 px tall, a polished scrollable homepage above-the-fold and first supporting sections. This is a visual design proposal, not implemented software.
References: first attached image is the AYRA DESKTOP application reference. Use it ONLY inside the MacBook display, simplify density, preserve the familiar left task sidebar and calm warm white UI. Second attachment is the approved logo asset; preserve that black diagonal-cut symbol and place beside the AYRA wordmark.
Hard boundary: the website is brand experience and desktop download portal. NO website dashboard, NO sidebar on website, NO online chat input, NO login/sign-in, NO web workspace action. Website navigation only Product, Security, Download.
Art direction: warm white #F7F6F2, white, soft gray, mist blue #EAF0F3, restrained pastel. Dark text #202629. Editorial elegant serif large headings (Georgia-like regular, not bold) paired with readable restrained sans-serif body. Large whitespace, Apple-like product photography, no saturated colors, no blue/purple gradients, no glassmorphism, no SaaS metrics.
Layout concept: refined left-aligned editorial hero. Large title LEFT reading exactly "AYRA" then "One workspace\nfor deeper work." Subtitle exactly "A unified AI workspace for research, execution, and creation." Beneath primary dark button "Download for macOS", secondary outlined "Download for Windows", tertiary quiet "Watch overview". Tiny honest caption "Design preview · Desktop release coming soon".
RIGHT of hero: beautiful photorealistic silver MacBook at subtle three-quarter angle, clearly keyboard/base visible, screen containing AYRA desktop Home based on first reference, its logo replaced by second reference symbol. Laptop on warm-white studio background, one hero visual center.
Below hero: sparse "What is AYRA" introduction: "A desktop home for your ideas, your work, and what comes next."
Next section: "Chat. Work. Build." three restrained evenly spaced content areas with thin outline icons, no illustrations competing with laptop, exact labels "Chat" / "Think with AI.", "Work" / "Turn ideas into outcomes.", "Build" / "Create software with AI."
Below: "Why AYRA" with four clean typographic entries: Context Continuity — AI remembers your work.; Unified Artifacts — Everything becomes usable output.; Long-running Agents — Complex work can continue.; Privacy First — Your data stays yours. Mark these as product principles in small header, not certifications.
Visible lower section lead-in "From a goal to a result." with Goal → Progress → Result as quiet editorial sequence.
Prioritize hierarchy, grouping, whitespace and typography before cards, borders or shadows. No cards within cards. Readable body at 16–18px scale. No made-up statistics, certifications, customer logos, model names, fake user avatars, or dates. Current date 2026-09-23 if needed, but omit dates. Crisp production-quality layout, faithful logo, no external annotations or concept number.

Use case ui-mockup. Generate one independent production-quality AYRA official MARKETING homepage design named "Product Gallery". Target 1440 px wide x 2000 px tall scrollable homepage concept. Reference 1 AYRA desktop Home and reference 2 desktop Work are only the product seen INSIDE the laptop display. Reference 3 is approved logo; preserve exact black diagonal-cut geometric symbol beside AYRA. Do not recreate a web app.
Hard requirements: marketing + brand experience + desktop download portal, no login, no online Chat/Build, no dashboard or workspace sidebar outside device, no pricing or made-up stats. Upper navigation AYRA at left; Product, Security, Download at right. Warm white #F7F6F2, chalk white, soft gray and mist blue #EAF0F3, dark charcoal #202629, muted accents only. No saturated blue, purple gradients, glassmorphism, decorative plant/cup/desk props. Use ample whitespace, architectural alignment, museum-like product presentation. Max two fonts: elegant regular editorial serif headings, modern neutral sans-serif text 16–18px.
Layout strategy: highly disciplined asymmetric split hero with generous margins and a very large pristine silver MacBook product photograph on the RIGHT on a pale solid mist-blue rectangular stage, shown nearly straight-on with subtle perspective, keyboard/base clearly visible. Display a simplified AYRA DESKTOP Work document UI based on reference 2: fixed navigation AYRA, Home, Chat, Work, Build, Projects, Activity, Settings, top Workspace/Search/Notification/Profile, large document center, resources secondary. Do not show IDE complexity or KPI grid. Device is the ONLY large hero imagery.
Hero LEFT exact typography: small "AYRA", huge "One workspace\nfor deeper work.", below "A unified AI workspace for research, execution, and creation." Primary dark button "Download for macOS", secondary outlined button "Download for Windows", quiet tertiary "Watch overview". Small caption "Design preview · Desktop release coming soon". Do not center the hero text above the MacBook.
Below hero a very quiet narrow What is AYRA introduction, exact heading "Your work. A little more connected." and short line "A desktop workspace for thinking, making, and moving forward."
Next "Chat. Work. Build." use three large horizontal minimalist tinted blocks at equal height with generous whitespace; just Chat — Think with AI.; Work — Turn ideas into outcomes.; Build — Create software with AI. No elaborate feature explanations.
Next Why AYRA use an editorial two-column section: large serif heading left "More continuity.\nLess friction.", four readable principle rows right separated by delicate rules: Context Continuity / AI remembers your work.; Unified Artifacts / Everything becomes usable output.; Long-running Agents / Complex work can continue.; Privacy First / Your data stays yours. Label as design principles, no certification claim.
Finish visible composition with a calm band "AYRA Desktop" and "A space for your next great idea." download CTA and a small Security link. Treat as concept excerpt of longer full page, not proof of shipped capabilities.
Focus primary hierarchy, no nested cards, no feature inventory, use spacing over boxes. Crisp legible text, no arbitrary badges, no testimonials, no dates or unsupported security claims. Current date 2026-09-23 if a date is needed but omit dates. No concept name or number printed on image.

Use case ui-mockup. Create one independent realistic production-quality AYRA official marketing homepage visual concept named "Calm Narrative". A complete scrollable homepage composition, target 1440 wide x 2560 px tall, legible and generously spaced. This is a design proposal, no web app implementation.
Attached reference 1 AYRA Home and reference 2 AYRA Chat are DESKTOP application styling only, to appear INSIDE a photorealistic silver MacBook display. Reference 3 is approved brand logo: retain its exact diagonal split symbol in charcoal, AYRA wordmark next to it. Do not invent an A-shaped logo.
Brand and surface rules: Website = Marketing + Brand + Desktop Download portal. No website workspace sidebar, no login, no live chat composer, no dashboard, no app controls outside the laptop. Desktop is the product. Warm white #F7F6F2, soft gray, mist blue #EAF0F3, subtle pastel small accents; charcoal #202629 type. Elegant regular editorial serif for main headings and neutral sans-serif for readable 16–18px body. No saturated colors, no blue/purple gradients, no glass, no nested cards, no decorative props or giant scenery backgrounds. Content over decoration.
Layout concept: quiet magazine narrative with consistent 120px side gutters, delicate rules and large vertical whitespace. Header AYRA left, Product Security Download right. HERO split: LEFT small AYRA then exact large title "One workspace\nfor deeper work." and subtitle "A unified AI workspace for research, execution, and creation." Primary "Download for macOS", secondary "Download for Windows", tertiary "Watch overview"; tiny caption "Design preview · Desktop release coming soon". RIGHT photorealistic slim silver MacBook at restrained angle, whole laptop visible including keyboard, screen showing a calm AYRA Desktop conversation and one document artifact panel derived from reference 2, simplified for clarity with sidebar Home Chat Work Build Projects Activity Settings. No floating UI cards outside device.
Below complete sections in this precise order:
1 What is AYRA. Heading "A desktop space for deeper work." One concise sentence explaining research, execution, creation in one workspace.
2 Chat. Work. Build. Three simple pastel rectangular cards, labels only: Chat / Think with AI.; Work / Turn ideas into outcomes.; Build / Create software with AI. No functional controls.
3 Why AYRA. Four small typographic columns, no boxes: Context Continuity / AI remembers your work.; Unified Artifacts / Everything becomes usable output.; Long-running Agents / Complex work can continue.; Privacy First / Your data stays yours. Mark section small label "PRODUCT PRINCIPLES".
4 AI Agent Capability. Headline "Give it a goal. Stay in control." One clean horizontal progression Goal → Progress → Result with very brief concrete example: "Prepare a research brief" → "AYRA is working…" → "Review your report". Show one small document outcome visual, not technical agents, models, MCP, memory graph, IDE, or feature list.
5 Privacy & Security. A calm two-column text section with small shield outline, heading "Your work deserves care." supporting copy "Understand permissions, approvals, and how your data is handled." Quiet link "Explore security". No certifications or promises of all-local/zero-data-transfer. Label as design intent, not verified security claim.
6 Download CTA. A simple warm-white section with large "AYRA Desktop", copy "A little more space. A lot more possibility.", the two OS download buttons and tiny "Desktop release coming soon". No Try Web CTA.
7 Minimal Footer: approved logo AYRA, Product / Download / Security; line "One workspace for deeper work."
All seven sections must fit comfortably without cramped microtext. Use two visual supporting areas max in each section and only one primary CTA in each area. No feature clutter or made-up metrics, no testimonials or customer logos. All visible desktop data is clearly illustrative design content. No dates needed; current date 2026-09-23 if needed. No concept number or annotation.
